papers.title_en: S-BFM: A Behavioral Foundation Model for Humanoid Control from Sparse Spatiotemporal Goals
papers.authors: Kun Yang, Xuanyu Chen, Jing Tan, Yanjing Liu, Yubo Zhao, Renjing Xu, Addison Lin Wang
papers.evidence: 从稀疏时空目标生成人形机器人全身运动
papers.tldr: 人形全身跟踪器依赖稠密参考轨迹，但任务常只给到达位置、姿态与时间。S-BFM 仅凭稀疏时空目标自行组织中间全身运动与节奏：空间重建引入世界坐标位置和朝向，时间条件蒸馏从稠密参考教师闭环学习运动与步速，生成式微调扩展可达距离与到达时间。仿真中全局关节位置误差较最佳基线降低逾32%，固定目标到达率由43.5%升至74.6%，终端位置误差从1.67米降至0.26米，并部署于全尺寸AGIBOT A3。
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose whole-body trackers can execute diverse humanoid motions, but they require dense reference trajectories. However, tasks usually specify only where, in which posture, and when the robot should arrive, leaving the motion in between to a separate planner. Inspired by human motor coordination, our key idea is that a low-level controller can organize the intervening motion and its pace by itself from sparse goals with arrival times. In this paper, we propose S-BFM, a novel behavioral foundation model superior in its autonomy: it generates whole-body transitions from target postures, poses, and arrival times alone. Specifically, we first introduce Spatial Grounding, which adds world-frame position and heading to a forward-backward behavior representation through spatial reconstruction. Then, Time-Conditioned Distillation is designed to learn transitions and pace from real motion through closed-loop imitation of a dense-reference teacher. Lastly, Generative Fine-Tuning is introduced to broaden the covered distances and arrival times with a distilled motion generator. In simulation, S-BFM lowers global joint-position error by over 32% relative to the best baseline under fixed and mixed horizons, and raises fixed-goal reach from 43.5% to 74.6% while cutting terminal position error from 1.67 to 0.26 m. We further deploy S-BFM on the full-size AGIBOT A3 humanoid. Sparse spatiotemporal goals thus suffice for natural, well-timed whole-body motion.

papers.title_en: Trust What Repeats: Capped World-Model Policy Gradients for Humanoid Motion Tracking
papers.evidence: 在仿真器中训练人形运动跟踪的世界模型策略梯度
papers.tldr: 世界模型反传想象回报可快速训练人形运动跟踪器，但想象梯度在仿真中的可信度存疑。作者在Unitree G1上发现高梯度rollout多不可复现，遂将动作梯度范数截断在批次中位数的10倍，并按预测梯度范数采样想象起点、重置低回报片段。方法将SuperMimic归一化回报从0.953提至0.967，最低1%片段从0.65提至0.76，持续跌倒片段减半。在LAFAN1上亦达0.935，优于0.906。
papers.abstract_en: Training a humanoid motion tracker by backpropagating imagined returns through a learned world model is fast, because the model gives a first-order policy gradient. We ask how much of that gradient holds in the simulator. On a tracker for the Unitree G1, the $0.5\%$ of imagined rollouts with the largest gradients carry $22\%$ of the summed gradient norm, yet neither a second rollout from the same state nor the simulator confirms them. When the actions are moved along the model's gradient, the simulator returns 94% of the predicted change in return where the gradient norm is below the batch median, 48% between 3 and 10 times the median, and 1% above 30 times; the part of a gradient that either check confirms stops growing at a few times the median. We therefore cap each rollout's action-gradient norm at 10 times the batch median, draw imagination starts in proportion to their predicted gradient norm so that the cap removes less, and reset episodes where the world model and critic predict the lowest return. Trained on 223 hours of motion and tested on 353 motions that no actor performed in training, the method raises the normalized return of SuperMimic, the baseline it builds on, from 0.953 to 0.967 and the lowest $1\%$ of test clips from 0.65 to 0.76, halves the test clips that fall persistently, from 15--18 to 7--10, and reaches the baseline's final return in 40% of the baseline's iterations and half its training time. On LAFAN1, trained and evaluated on the same clips as prior work, it reaches 0.935 against 0.906.

papers.title_en: Humanoid robots for safety-critical electrical switching: A perception-informed runtime constraint filter
papers.authors: Songyang Liu, Yu Hou, Yuqing Hu, Shuai Li
papers.evidence: 面向人形机器人控制的感知信息运行时安全滤波器
papers.tldr: 在安全关键电气开关场景中，人形机器人可降低人员暴露，但VR遥操作时工具接近目标开关易误碰相邻同类设备。本文提出运行时安全过滤器，利用头部相机估计场景模型，并以目标条件控制屏障函数二次规划约束工具运动，安全指令原样放行。Unitree G1真机两站位各六轮共十轮全部成功且无误操作，仿真安全完成9/9，优于原始遥操作5/9。结果表明该方法可提升人形机器人电气开关操作的安全性。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots can reduce personnel exposure in electrical switching, but safe control is challenging because the tool must reach a target switch next to similar devices, where an imprecise operator command can contact a non-target switch. This study proposes a runtime safety filter that checks each operator command during virtual-reality teleoperation of a humanoid robot. The filter integrates a scene model estimated from the robot head camera and a target-conditioned control barrier function quadratic program that keeps the tool away from the non-target switch while passing safe commands unchanged. In real-world experiments on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, with six rounds at each of two standing positions, target operations succeed in all ten rounds with an unchanged target and no non-target actuation. A simulation study achieves 9/9 safe completions, compared with 5/9 for raw teleoperation, demonstrating the feasibility of the method for humanoid switching operations.

papers.title_en: What Must a Model Tell a Planner? Outcome Interfaces for Risk-Aware Planning After Robot Damage
papers.evidence: 在H1人形上基于结果接口的风险感知路径规划
papers.tldr: 机器人受损后需在风险约束下重选可行路线，学习模型是否有用取决于它向规划器提供何种决策接口。研究在Go2四足与H1人形仿真中比较决策策略、固定惩罚策略、结果模型与能力契约四类接口。能力契约用少量低风险探测即可近似逐地形多次试验的风险排序；在5%不可行选择限制下，结果模型把Go2任务放弃率从约32%降至7–8%，H1从57%降至35–36%。这表明预测结果而非直接给动作，能让规划器随风险收紧改道并保留任务。
papers.abstract_en: When a robot is damaged, it must decide which routes it can still afford, and the amount of risk it may accept can change from one mission to the next. We argue that whether a learned model helps such a robot depends on its decision interface, that is, on what the model hands to the planner. A decision policy tells the planner what to do, whereas an outcome model, a kind of world model, predicts the consequences of each route. We study simulated Unitree Go2 quadrupeds and H1 humanoids with weakened motors, added payloads, or reduced foot friction. We compare four interfaces. The first is a decision policy, and the second is the same policy trained with fixed penalties for infeasible routes. The third is an outcome model that predicts the feasibility and travel time of each route. The fourth, which we call a capability contract, is an outcome model that predicts the chance of success and the travel time of the robot on each terrain and composes them along a route. All share the same collected experience, matched tuning and risk calibration, and an uncertainty guard. Two comparatively low-risk probes let the capability contract rank hazardous terrains about as well as four new trials on every hazard. At a calibrated 5% limit on selecting empirically infeasible routes, outcome models cut declined missions from about 32% to 7-8% on Go2 and from 57% to 35-36% on H1 compared with the plain policy. Fixed penalties narrow this gap, but the best penalty changes with the risk target. Predicting outcomes lets the planner preserve missions by changing routes as risk requirements tighten.

papers.title_en: Efficient VLA Reinforcement Learning via Subchunk Rollouts in Latent World Models
papers.authors: Nan Tang, Han-Tao Zhang, Jing-Cheng Pang, Hao-Nan Wang, Hao-Xiang Ren, Yi-Fei Sheng, Jun-Yin Ye, Tian Xu, Fan-Ming Luo, Hao-Xin Lin, Yang Yu
papers.evidence: 基于模型强化学习的视觉-语言-动作策略改进
papers.tldr: 现有VLA强化学习多依赖大规模图像或视频生成世界模型，计算开销高；潜空间世界模型更高效，却受递归预测误差累积和与VLA视觉输入接口不兼容困扰。LS-MBPO提出轻量残差MBRL框架，以分层强制、潜空间子块滚动和进度条件分支起点课程，结合冻结VLA动作块与潜残差策略逐子块精炼。在LIBERO、RoboTwin和真实ALOHA机器人上，其任务性能和训练效率均优于现有方法，为预训练VLA提供高效想象式改进路径。
papers.abstract_en: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) can improve pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies through imagined experiences. However, existing VLA-MBRL methods primarily rely on large-scale image or video generation world models, incurring large computational overhead. Latent world models offer a more efficient alternative but face two challenges: compounding errors during recursive prediction and incompatibility with VLAs' visual input interfaces. In this work, we propose LS-MBPO, a lightweight residual MBRL framework that leverages latent world models to improve upon pretrained VLAs. LS-MBPO introduces two key techniques: (1) Hierarchical Forcing, which combines dense causal supervision with autoregressive feedback to mitigate compounding prediction errors; and (2) Latent Subchunk Rollouts, which leverage action chunks from a frozen VLA policy and a latent residual policy for successive subchunk refinement, bridging the gap between latent imagination and VLA policy execution. We further introduce a Progress-Conditioned Branch-Start Curriculum that progressively shifts rollout starting points from later to earlier task stages, enabling effective policy learning from short imagined rollouts. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and a real-world ALOHA robot show that LS-MBPO achieves superior task performance and training efficiency compared to existing methods.
